newsitem.title: UK: Bulmer progress subject to Christmas trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulmer progress subject to Christmas trade.

text.p: Cider-maker H.P. Bulmer Holdings Plc said it expects further progress over the year as a whole subject to its performance in the important Christmas period.

Chairman Esmond Bulmer told shareholders at the company's AGM that market share in both on and off trade continued to increase and sales of premium packaged ciders in the first four months of the current year compared favourably with the same period last year.
A spokesman for the company later said that such sales were up eight percent in volume terms.
But Bulmer said that sales this year compare reasonably with 1995 when they were especially buoyant given the very hot summer.

Bulmer conceded that "alcopops" have established a significant presence but said its own well-established brands, in which the company continues to invest, have shown resilience in the face of this new sector.
Bulmer shares were 7.5p higher after the statement at 560p having come under pressure earlier this week in the wake of a profits warning by fellow cider-maker Matthew Clark.
Clark's share price has collapsed to 365p per share, compared to 670p before the profit alert.
